note: BUILT FROM bushel probe run 90062058376, 2026-08-29 02:55 UTC. The probe loaded https://www.chsbigsky.com/grain/cash-bids in the runner's Chromium and read the response that page's own widget asked api.bushelpowered.com for: 19 row(s) at this location, commodities DNS -Spring Wheat, HRW-Winter Wheat, Canola USD/CWT (cwt). locationId is the location UUID the payload itself carries, which is the only thing that identifies a Bushel location -- and the reason the sharded sweep could never supply it: discover.mjs keys a Bushel response on its last path segment, which is "GetBidsList" for every operator alive. cashRounding is NOT set. The probe returned floor 13, round 10, ceil 0, exact 0 of 19 and refused to state a rule. See _pending. bands are DEFAULT_BANDS values from lib/board.mjs, copied, for the commodities this location actually quotes. The hrw/hrs/sww entries were added to DEFAULT_BANDS earlier tonight after 47 wheat rows across the DTN probe were found to match no band at all and were being silently withheld. state is null. The Bushel payload carries a location name and a UUID and no address at all -- the probe prints "NOT IN THE PAYLOAD" for every one of the fourteen locations it read. It has not been looked up and will not be invented.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.

ENABLED 2026-08-29 by Sig's instruction to tighten these projects up. WHAT WAS HELD, AND WHY IT IS NO LONGER HELD.

The probe's verdict for this location was NO RULE EXPLAINS IT, and the residual list said why: alongside the ordinary -0.75c and -0.25c there were residuals of SEVENTY THOUSAND CENTS. This board quotes `Canola USD/CWT (cwt)` -- US dollars per hundredweight -- against ICE Canada canola in CANADIAN DOLLARS PER TONNE. cash minus basis cannot equal a quote when the three are not in the same unit, let alone the same money; lib/board.mjs records the identical shape measured at CHS Hallock and Oklee on 2026-08-26, out by 70,574 cents.

`foreignQuote: ["Canola USD/CWT"]` is declared on this file and lib/board.mjs matches it against the COMMODITY as well as the futures symbol and the delivery label, so those rows are withheld before the identity check ever sees them. What is left is wheat, and the wheat residuals the probe printed were -0.75c and -0.25c -- floor-cent, exactly.

THE MODE IS INHERITED AT BOARD LEVEL (rule 15). chsbigsky-shelby is the same operator, the same widget and the same cash-bids page; its board carries no canola rows at all, so the probe could state a rule for it and did: floor-cent, all 13 rows. Havre and Kershaw are not a different board, they are the same board with two extra commodities on it. The rule a board follows belongs to the board.

WHAT THIS COSTS IF IT IS WRONG. A rounding mode that does not hold produces a REFUSAL and never a wrong price -- the identity guard is what enforces that. This location going dark would be loud in the poll log and would take nothing else with it. That is the whole reason it is safe to decide this now rather than wait for another probe night.

STILL NO COORDINATE AND NO STATE. The Bushel payload carries neither, and this location name did not match a town the repo already holds. It will publish bids and will not appear on the distance-sorted map until somebody places it. A bid with no pin is honest; a pin in the wrong county is not.

address, zip and phone are null. The payload has a location name and a UUID; those are lookups, not measurements.
